scope: Sampled-peak target definitions; not a reconstruction of raw telemetry
sampling_interval_source: Study target specification; historical per-sample scrape configuration is not supplied

memory.denominator: Total job-allocated memory from Slurm AllocTRES
memory.assumption: Equal allocated memory per node within a job; numerator and denominator use consistent units
memory.interpretation: Maximum sampled per-node utilization ratio, not simultaneous aggregate usage

vram.denominator: Corresponding per-device capacity from the external site inventory
vram.assumption: Homogeneous GPUs within each job; usage and capacity use consistent units

missingness.partial_gaps: Omit absent observations from the sampled peak; unobserved spikes are not recovered
missingness.no_valid_resource_samples: Invalid resource label, excluded from that resource loss and metrics
missingness.replay_assumption: Recorded resource labels become available at recorded job completion

pipeline_input: Precomputed exported mem_max and vram_max ratios; experiment code does not regenerate raw Prometheus peaks
